device: Desktop and narrow viewport emulation; not a physical device

editorialImageInspection.method: Opened all 41 contact sheets with image inspection at original resolution. The sheets preserve native figure pixels: 174 state/viewport captures plus 63 right-scrolled table captures. Opened the ambiguous reduced demo-total image separately at native size and confirmed its correct 8/0 values.
findings: All 87 authored states were inspected at both viewport widths; no concrete visual-content or layout defect was found in this pass.

Mobile nodes stack and state controls wrap; equations and labels remain legible. The correction example retains 18/1 to 20/1 and the migration rollback points from the new active path to the old fallback.

Wide tables scroll inside a keyboard-reachable, labeled region with a visible sideways-scroll hint. Both left and right positions were inspected; this intentional local scrolling does not overflow the page.
Public overview sheets are reduced initial-state previews, not a substitute for native-size text inspection. Full raw captures and native contact sheets stay outside the checkout.
editorialImageInspection.limits: Chromium viewport emulation, not physical-device or comprehensive assistive-technology certification. This record covers the 68 authored teaching visuals, not every page or video frame.
